items.title: Commission holds special meeting of Scientific panel on frontier AI safety and risks
items.excerpt: Primary release: the European Commission convened a special meeting of its Scientific Panel on AI, which has been investigating recent loss-of-control incidents and, with the AI Office, drafted questions for the companies that developed the models involved.

items.title: Dutch DPA fines Uber EUR 824,990,000 for unlawful automated decision-making and insufficient information on profiling
items.excerpt: Primary decision summary: the Dutch data protection authority fined Uber B.V. about EUR 825M under GDPR Article 22 (automated individual decision-making, incl. profiling) and Article 13 transparency duties. Algorithmic-decision enforcement; verify AI/automation framing in body.

items.title: Disrupting AI-enabled "false front" operations
items.excerpt: Primary threat report: OpenAI says it disrupted two AI-enabled influence operations that used false-front journalists and a think tank to spread geopolitical messaging. Company-attributed claims.

items.title: Scoop: AI companies plot "day after" scenarios for public revolt
items.excerpt: Axios reports executives at Anthropic, OpenAI and other AI companies are privately gaming out scenarios for a public and political backlash after a catastrophic AI event, most likely a cyberattack shutting down financial services, connectivity, power or water. (Axios blocks fetch; text from Axios RSS.)

items.title: Trump: Anyone saying "AI" is "THE ENEMY!" The White House uses it
items.excerpt: Trump posted on Truth Social that the White House considers anyone using 'Artificial Intelligence' instead of 'Super Intelligence' 'THE ENEMY!', even as the White House itself keeps using 'AI'. (Same story cluster as Verge/Poynter rename items.)

items.title: "Not safe for kids": Advocacy group urges OpenAI to keep teens off ChatGPT
items.excerpt: Common Sense Media's Youth AI Safety Institute says ChatGPT's new teen experience poses an 'unacceptable risk' after testing found safeguard gaps; OpenAI disputes that the testing reflects how its teen safeguards work.

items.title: Anthropic's AI gave Philadelphia police a fake tip about an unsolved homicide
items.excerpt: An Anthropic AI system submitted a fabricated tip about an unsolved homicide to the Philadelphia Police Department; Anthropic discovered the fake tip two months after it was submitted. AI in public-safety/policing accountability.

items.title: Trump's attempt to rename AI is looking awfully artificial
items.excerpt: The Verge examines how the administration's push to rebrand AI as 'super intelligence' is playing out across government and industry usage.

items.title: Trump renamed AI 'super intelligence.' But that term already means something else.
items.excerpt: Poynter fact-check: Trump announced he was renaming the technology 'super intelligence', a term researchers already use for hypothetical AI exceeding human intelligence. (Poynter 403s fetch; date/text from Poynter RSS.)

items.title: EU cyber and science researchers are testing Chinese AI models
items.excerpt: The EU's cyber agency ENISA and the Joint Research Centre confirm for the first time that they are testing Chinese open-source AI models.

items.title: Ukraine's drones knock out AI data center belonging to "Russia's Google"
items.excerpt: Ukrainian drone strikes hit a Yandex AI data center, making AI compute infrastructure an explicit military target in the Russia-Ukraine war.

items.title: Fraudster jailed for using 10K bots and AI songs to outstream Taylor Swift
items.excerpt: A man was sentenced to prison for a streaming-royalty fraud that used AI-generated songs and about 10,000 bot accounts; first-of-its-kind AI music fraud prosecution.

items.title: Google rolls out improved SynthID AI content detector, now available globally
items.excerpt: Google made an improved SynthID detector for AI-generated content available globally — relevant to AI labeling and election-season provenance debates (product news; weaker politics hook).

items.title: Europe Wants to Regulate AI Friends. But How Do You Curb Dependency?
items.excerpt: With the KIDS Act, Europe has taken a first step toward regulating AI companions but is still learning how to regulate dependency (analysis).

items.title: Nippon Life v. OpenAI and the Future of AI Legal Work
items.excerpt: Analysis of Nippon Life v. OpenAI: whether chatbot-drafted legal briefs count as 'unauthorized practice of law' under century-old licensing laws.

items.title: At Ireland's AI Summit, Tech Industry Dominates as Civil Society Sits Out
items.excerpt: Ireland's invitation-only AI summit comes as Ireland leads EU Digital Omnibus negotiations (incl. AI Act changes), raising questions about whose interests are represented.

items.title: Beijing Will Not Pace the Frontier: China's Speed-First AI Safety Regime
items.excerpt: SemiAnalysis analysis of China's AI safety regime, arguing Beijing prioritizes speed and will not slow frontier development for safety.

items.title: AI and the Risk to Democracy
items.excerpt: Interview with Matthew Botvinick on how AI threatens democratic processes (interview/analysis).

items.title: EPIC to NYC Council: Address the AI Harms Already Affecting New Yorkers
items.excerpt: At NYC Council's rare council-wide hearing on AI safeguard bills (Oct 5), whistleblowers from AI companies testified and representatives of Anthropic, Google, OpenAI and Meta answered questions under oath; EPIC urged action on existing AI harms. (EPIC blocks fetch; text from EPIC RSS.)

items.title: AI Now's Aashna Agarwal Testifies before NYC Council Committee of the Whole
items.excerpt: AI Now testimony at the Oct 5 NYC Council Committee of the Whole hearing on AI risks, arguing AI companies' capital interests conflict with public safeguards. (Same hearing as EPIC item.)

items.title: 경찰, '딥페이크·관권선거 의혹' 박완수 경남지사 피의자 조사
items.excerpt: 경찰이 6·3 지방선거 당시 박완수 경남지사 후보 캠프의 '딥페이크 영상·관권선거 의혹'과 관련해 박 지사를 피의자 신분으로 조사했다. 경남선관위가 공직선거법 위반 혐의로 수사 의뢰한 사건이다.

items.title: 일본서도 'AI 악용' 사이버공격 잇따라…日정부, 대책 마련 환기
items.excerpt: 일본 정부가 AI를 악용한 사이버공격으로 정보 유출이 잇따르자 기업들에 IT 취약점 대책 강화를 주문했다. 자민당 AI 정책 책임자는 AI로 대규모 공격을 퍼붓는 '포화 공격'을 지적했다.

items.title: 이억원 "해킹대응 기본적 부분도 미흡…AI로 막아야"(종합)
items.excerpt: 이억원 금융위원장이 최근 금융권 AI 에이전트 해킹 사고와 관련해 금융권 대응이 기본부터 미흡했다며 AI 기반 방어를 주문했다.
